entities.summary: The chief of the Cabinet of Ministers of the Argentine Nation, more commonly known simply as the Cabinet chief is a ministerial office within the government of Argentina tasked with overseeing the government's general administration and acting as a link between the national executive and the Argentine National Congress. The position was created by the 1994 amendment to the Argentine Constitution.
